ja: • カシオペアは上野～札幌間運行の寝台列車。「快適空間を実現した寝台列車」のコンセプトのもと、全室A個室寝台列車として開発。
• 寝台車10両、食堂車１両、ラウンジ車１両の12両編成（カヤ27が使用される場合はラウンジ車なし）。
• JR初のオール２階建て寝台客車で、客室は「カシオペアスイート」「カシオペアデラックス」「カシオペアツイン」の３種類。
• Bセットは客車（カハフE26）×１両、客車（スロネフE26）×１両、客車（スロネE27－100）×１両の３両セット。
• NEW SGフレーム、ステッカー付属。カシオペアロゴ、帯等の装飾はステッカーで再現。
en: • Cassiopeia is a sleeper train that operates between Ueno and Sapporo. Based on the concept of a "sleeper train that provides a comfortable space," this train was developed as an all-A private sleeper train.
• A 12-car train consisting of 10 sleeping cars, 1 dining car, and 1 lounge car (no lounge car if Kaya 27 is used).
• This is JR's first all-two-story sleeper passenger car, with three types of guest rooms: "Cassiopeia Suite," "Cassiopeia Deluxe," and "Cassiopeia Twin."
• Set B is a 3-car set consisting of 1 passenger car (Kahaf E26), 1 passenger car (Sronev E26), and 1 passenger car (Sronev E27-100).
• NEW SG frame and sticker included. Decorations such as the Cassiopeia logo and obi are reproduced with Stickers.
